defectsFoundAndFixedInThisPhase: Required checks failed for environment reasons and reported those as failures about the code. PATHEXT -- not PATH -- was what broke bare `npm`; 284 agent tests died on `spawnSync git ENOENT`.

A missing git made ProjectOS assert false governance facts: readCommittedJson returns null both when a record is absent and when git cannot be asked, and all ten callers read that null as a fact about the RECORD.
Owner Chat answered a reviewer-cost question with phase progress, confidently and wrongly; `how much` was a PROGRESS phrase and no cost intent existed.

Two of those call sites survived the first sweep because they are written across multiple lines and the search was line-oriented. Found by the gatekeeper's own review, not by me.

isInside compared paths lexically while its docstring claimed filesystem resolution, so a directory junction pointing into the governed checkout bypassed the guard. Closed in bound-cargo.cjs AND worker/bound-git.cjs, proven with a real junction.

Cargo resolved but could not LINK: the real daemon carries five environment variables and no TEMP/TMP/windir/SystemDrive, and Rust's msvc target needs the Visual Studio linker. Found only by running the installed application.
